mapper.select: SELECT member_no, username, password, nickname, role, enabled, profile_image, withdrawn, provider, provider_id, created_at FROM member WHERE username = #{username}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member (username, password, nickname, role, enabled, created_at) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{nickname}, 'ROLE_USER', 1, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET withdrawn = 1, withdrawn_at = NOW(), enabled = 0 WHERE username = #{username}
